advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 79/94 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.354 over 94 corners (69 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 14.43; 3/4 launches spun

advice.text: Fronts run 15 F+ hotter than rears: the understeer thermal signature — check pressures/camber on the HUD (Tires Misc + Heat).
advice.evidence: median F 206 F vs R 182 F

advice.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 16 stops (1 both-axle, 4 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.55) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Launch wheelspin only in 3/4 launches — inconsistent (surface, temps or throttle?). Two more standing launches on the same surface.
